messages.author: 51ea28fc190ac537
messages.subject: R Journal Article on Rattle
parts:
Dear Rattle Users,

The new R Journal has published an article on Rattle that may be of
interest to the group:

http://journal.r-project.org/archive/2009-2/2009-2_index.html

Also note that Rattle continues to be actively developed. It is now
regularly uploaded to CRAN and so can be directly updated from there.
Current is version 2.5.15. A change Log is available from

http://code.google.com/p/rattle/source/list

Though it is rather brief for each entry, it does capture all changes.

Keep an eye out for the upcoming book in the Springer UseR! series on
Data Mining in R, using Rattle. You can get a bit of a flavour of the
book from

http://datamining.togaware.com/survivor/Data_Mining.html

although the book material has progressed quite a bit since the
website snapshot.

Regards,
Graham
